LESSON: SELF- AWARENESS 1.0 CREATION

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is your name?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. mention their names for identification and self-awareness
2. recognize that God knows them by their names as part of His creation
3. appreciate themselves as unique and special creation before God. Core-Competences to be developed: Self-efficacy; children will engage in activities involving appreciating themselves, communication and collaboration; group and pair up as they mention their names and sing songs, imagination and creativity; draw and write their names

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. mention their names for identification and self-awareness
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to mention their names for identification and self-awareness. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. recognize that God knows them by their names as part of His creation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognize that God knows them by their names as part of His creation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate themselves as unique and special creation before God. Core-Competences to be developed: Self-efficacy; children will engage in activities involving appreciating themselves, communication and collaboration; group and pair up as they mention their names and sing songs, imagination and creativity; draw and write their names
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate themselves as unique and special creation before God. Core-Competences to be developed: Self-efficacy; children will engage in activities involving appreciating themselves, communication and collaboration; group and pair up as they mention their names and sing songs, imagination and creativity; draw and write their names. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
2. Explain Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
4. Show that you can: mention their names for identification and self-awareness
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What is your name?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. mention their names for identification and self-awareness
2. recognize that God knows them by their names as part of His creation
3. appreciate themselves as unique and special creation before God. Core-Competences to be developed: Self-efficacy; children will engage in activities involving appreciating themselves, communication and collaboration; group and pair up as they mention their names and sing songs, imagination and creativity; draw and write their names

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
